test.name: Log the overview to the research log and hand back its search implications
test.description: Issue #3244 option L + D+: inside a project, with projectPath given, the overview is saved as one historical_context research-log entry (full overview in notes, beside one entry per wiki/Wikipedia lookup), and the return carries a Search implications block naming hypothesis-tracking for candidate explanations and research-plan for where/when facts.

input.delegation:
Patrick Flynn's 1908 death record says he was born in Pennsylvania about 1845, but his family was Irish. Give me a historical overview of why a record might say that, and what it means for where I search next.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: The return ends its narrative with a `### Search implications` block, above the `---` line, with a `hypothesis-tracking:` label and a `research-plan:` label (either may read `none`).

At least one competing explanation for the Pennsylvania birthplace (e.g. immigrated as a young child and reported the first state of residence; informant error by a later-life informant) is handed back to hypothesis-tracking by name, not tested or resolved in the reply.
Facts that change where or when to search (e.g. passenger lists or naturalization records for an arrival before 1850) are handed back to research-plan by name. The agent spawns neither agent itself.

The overview is logged as one `historical_context` entry in the file changes summary, its notes holding the full overview; the per-lookup entries carry null notes. Their count and shape are checked by validators, not by you.
